notes.title: RIVANDY WEBSITE – REDESIGN
notes.content: [p][/p][p]The Rivandy website has a [b]brand-new look[/b]![/p][p][url="https://rivandy.com/"]https://rivandy.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]What you’ll find there:[/p][list][*][p]Game information[/p][/*][*][p]Modes (Battle Royale, Survivor, Streamer…)[/p][/*][*][p]Characters, spirits, and spells[/p][/*][*][p]Latest news & patch notes integrated with Steam[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44769407/d857a62c88dcb603c822e0b995b4520730b7603c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44769407/00479ae4b391adc8994b03b5a5de7ddd899fdc98.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patchnote – Update [v3.0.008]
notes.content: [h1] Patchnote – Update \[v0.0.008][/h1][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed issues related to [i]Dash[/i].[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Features & Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]The restricted zone for players in [i]Survivor[/i] mode is now visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [i]Spectator Mode[/i] interface.[/p][list][*][p]Spectators can move freely and watch battles.[/p][/*][*][p]It is still possible to leave the match using the menu buttons.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a UI hint during [i]Battle Royale[/i] cooldown indicating that pressing [b]F5[/b] displays the spell information of both your character and your spirit.[/p][/*][*][p]New map: Lavalon ![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44769407/e34e366779421ad51aa687ca52684992739031a1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patchnote – Update [v3.0.007]
notes.content: [h1] Patchnote – Update \[v0.0.007][/h1][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Souls are now automatically removed after 1 minute.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed monster push: monsters now fall smoothly.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fix: resolved an issue where spells were removed after being stunned while still active.[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Features & Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Shop rework.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a timer when joining matchmaking.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a timer and visual display of ongoing matchmaking, even when switching pages.[/p][/*][*][p]It is now possible to use mouse scroll in the character gallery.[/p][/*][*][p]Killing a player now grants 10 additional souls and heals 15 health points.[/p][/*][*][p]Some spell sounds have been modified.[/p][/*][*][p]New sounds have been added for certain spells.[/p][/*][*][p]Kyren’s illustrations have been redone.[/p][/*][*][p]Niklaus’s illustration has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Guldir’s illustration has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]New character: [b]Kyren[/b] is now available. Discover the Anti-Magic Templar![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44769407/3f94585d17dcc6aa17523f22f1e8b5dac3a380ca.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Added a leaderboard for Survivor mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a leaderboard for Battle Royale mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Update: English version is now aligned with the French version.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Monsters are now affected by pull / knockback spells.[/p][/*][*][p]Some Survivor mode monster spells have been adjusted.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Niklaus[/h3][list][*][p] The *Dragon Charge* spell can only hit the same enemy once.[/p][/*][*][p]The *Tornado* spell now deals less damage.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patchnote – Update [v3.0.006]
notes.content: [h1]Patchnote – Update \[v3.0.006][/h1][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the map displaying extra player icons.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the map not perfectly following the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the map displaying all players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the map showing extra player icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the map not perfectly following the player.[/p][/*][/list][h2] New Features & Improvements[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44769407/635df00e1bbe5e97376aab9284ad6729c58c672f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44769407/5460c20fe1574c6593ad9bf0409ac00d45adfe88.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Added a minimap that follows the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Revised the map design.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a display to view character and spirit information (F5).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a display in the character selection screen to view the chosen character and spirit information.[/p][/*][*][p]Added spell icons for all spirits.[/p][/*][*][p]Revised icons for many characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the zone to the minimap.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44769407/9881b94ccbfaf518f4b5307cf1090770dc88f6a2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patchnote – Update [v3.0.005]
notes.content: [h1]Patchnote – Update \[v3.0.005][/h1][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p]- Fixed the floating value of EXP in the match recap.[/p][p]- The “New record” text and records for Battle Royale are now correct (the lower the rank, the better).[/p][p]- The “Nouveau record” text will no longer appear for now.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where home screen buttons could be highlighted at the same time.[/p][p]- Fixed the “Quit Game” button clicking on “Leave Group” instead.[/p][p]- Players should no longer be affected by other players' attacks in Survivor mode, even if they are not in the same group.[/p][p]- Survivor: fixed the damage bonus and changed it from +2% to +5%.[/p][p]- Survivor: fixed the cooldown reduction bonus and changed it from +2% to +5%.[/p][p]- Survivor: fixed the number of health points gained which was higher than the number of bonuses collected.[/p][p]- Monsters will no longer be blocked by invisible walls at the edges of the Survivor map.[/p][p]- General: the number of health points displayed at the start of the game is no longer 0/0.[/p][h2] New Features & Improvements[/h2][p]- Added a visual indicator and sound effect when a player is killed, displaying the name of the killed and the killer.[/p][p]- Matchmaking: instead of “players waiting: X / players missing: Y”, it now displays “Searching for players: X/Y” (Y being the total number of players required to start).[/p][p]- Survivor: removed the one-minute wait before starting the match. The match now starts instantly (unlike Battle Royale).[/p][p]- Survivor & Battle Royale: monsters now lose collision immediately upon death, making it easier to collect souls in Battle Royale.[/p][p]- Discord: the “Now Playing” status is now displayed.[/p][p]- Removed irrelevant / undeveloped modes from the mode selection list.[/p][p]- Restructured the sound system.[/p][p]- Added music to the authentication screen.[/p][p]- Added music to the main menu.[/p][p]- Added sounds for:[/p][p]  - Button hover[/p][p]  - Button unhover[/p][p]  - Button enable/disable[/p][p]  - Button click[/p][p]  - Matchmaking: searching for players[/p][p]  - Matchmaking: match start[/p][p]  - Matchmaking: added a button to cancel the search[/p][p]  - Soul collection[/p][p]- Added a zone reduction timer.[/p][p]- Added a pre-zone reduction countdown.[/p][p]- If the maximum number of players is reached for a match, the one-minute wait is skipped and players are instantly teleported. Otherwise, the one-minute wait remains.[/p][h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2][p]- **Diaby**: increased auto-attack damage.[/p][p]- **Dash**:[/p][p]  - Cooldown: 5 seconds → 3 seconds.[/p][p]  - Velocity: 12 → 15.[/p][p]- Survivor: removed the ability to stun allies.[/p][p]- Battle Royale: maximum lives obtained per soul increased from 3 to 5.[/p][p]- General: default player health increased from 100 to 250.[/p]
